source.name: Torino FC, 'MAGLIA HOME 2026/27: È QUESTIONE DI CASA'
source.quote: Acrobatica rinnova la propria presenza come Back Partner.
source.note: Translation: 'Acrobatica renews its presence as Back Partner.' Deal value not disclosed; the start year of the back-of-shirt deal is not stated on the page. CEO Anna Marras, quoted in the club's 22 August 2026 announcement, speaks of a collaboration consolidated 'dopo anni' (after years).

note: Renewed for 2026/27; the club's partner page lists Edilizia Acrobatica as Back Partner.
